KNIGHT'S THRESHOLD, and Harris's whole timing argument. General Average 'could function well under uncertainty, even high uncertainty' because nothing is priced before the event - which is why it predates premium insurance by a millennium or more. THE LIMIT Harris names: it 'provided no relief in the event of sinking and total loss', where there is nothing left to average.
STRUCTURALLY CERTAIN: mortality risk is mutualised among subscribers and no outsider bears it - the state pays a fixed total and survivors divide it. Coded on structure, not on a source.

THE FALSIFICATION TEST, NOT YET RUNNABLE. If the hazard-to-pricing sequence holds, pooling forms should code PR1=0. The tontine is the candidate counter-example: subscribers grouped into age classes is ex-ante actuarial pricing inside a pooling form. If it codes PR1=1 the sequence collapses and pricing is orthogonal to mechanism rather than a stage of it. TWO PROBLEMS FIRST: (i) no source to hand - Harris 2023 does not treat tontines, and coding this from general knowledge would breach the repo's own rule; (ii) 'tontine' probably spans pre- and post-actuarial forms, so one row may not hold it and the type may need splitting by period.

Harris's category applies on structure: mortality risk is mutualised among subscribers, the state pays a fixed total, no outsider bears it. Coded on structure, not on a source - the caveat inherited from LM-0077 stands.

THE DISCRIMINATING CELL, half of it. No differentiation by nominee age: a single rate irrespective of the life named, which is why nominees were selected young and why Halley advised against the scheme. Pairs with tontine_fr_royal PR1=1 - same mechanism, same decade, opposite value. Vault: [[Pricing is orthogonal to mitigation mechanism not a stage of it]].

THE STRUCTURAL POINT. Survivors draw irrespective of any loss suffered. This is the cell separating the tontine from general_average (individual-indemnity) and from averia_pool (collective-good): the draw corresponds to no adverse realisation of the recipient's, so the arrangement concentrates a fixed aggregate onto long trajectories.

CHARACTERISTIC INADEQUATE - coded under protest. The trigger is ANOTHER subscriber's death, not the recipient's own life event, and PY1's allowed values name the kind of event without a locator. As coded this reads identically to widows_fund_scotland PY1, where the trigger is the member's own. Sereno well-formedness failure (CHARACTER-CODING test 1); split proposed in logbook 6.

No allowed value expresses survivorship accrual: rotation-lot, rotation-fixed, auction, indemnity and need-assessed all miss it. Recorded .NR rather than forced into the nearest wrong value. Depends on the PY1 repair.

Mortality across unrelated nominees is about as decorrelated as an early modern hazard gets. NOTE THE IMPLICATION: the tontine PASSES the correlation test that averia_pool fails (HZ1=covariate) and is variance-amplifying anyway. A subscription, not a levy. Contrast averia_pool MB3=compulsory.

THE ACTUAL SITE OF THE PRICING STORY. De Witt's Waardije van Lyf-renten naer Proportie van Los-renten values life annuities against redeemable ones because Holland sold them at a flat fourteen years' purchase irrespective of the nominee's age and was arbitraged by parents nominating healthy children. Hudde supplied the Amsterdam registers; Halley 1693 supplied the survival function and the summed product of survival probability and discount factor.
inapplicable: not a fund with an output - cf. sea_loan LM-0033

Membership constituted by the 規約書 (rules of association), not by locality: 表1 places members across present-day Higashi-Osaka, Yao, Kashiwara, Osaka city and Kyoto. Locality would have been the expected value for a village kō and is falsified here.

A subscription under a private 規約書. Contrast averia_pool MB3=compulsory.

NO FITTING VALUE, same gap as tanomoshi_oya GV1. The 講元 is the temple, simultaneously organiser and principal beneficiary. Neither collective, elder-fixed, nor external-administered describes an insider-organiser who is also the intended recipient. 田中's own term is 寺社を講元とする頼母子講.

Credit is priced and peril is not — same reading as tanomoshi_oya PR1. Rates are explicit in 表4 (利率20両ニ付1分, 利金6両 on 元金20両) and in 史料10 (利足金弐分弐朱宛). No probability of any peril enters. Observed absence of ex-ante PERIL pricing, not silence.
広域講 (multi-village kō), 講元 碓井村伴吾 of the 松倉 house — 下館藩石川氏河内領大庄屋 and 代官 of a 旗本知行所. Mutualised among members; no outsider bears anything.

Subscription under a 仕法帳. No levy.
壱ヶ年ニ会両度ツヽ相勤 — two 参会 per year.

当選銀 goes to the winner of each round irrespective of any loss.
一、御当鬮又ハ落札之御方者、其会限リニ御退可被成候事 — a member who has won retires from subsequent draws, so entitlement is strictly positional.

NO FITTING VALUE — AND THIS IS THE FINDING, NOT A GAP. 一、…尤初会入札、弐会目振鬮、終リ迄一会替リニいたし、廿五会相勤 — the first round is decided by BID (入札), the second by LOT (振鬮), alternating to the twenty-fifth. Residual distributed to the five undrawn members at the 弐拾六会.

Here 銀預り are 古市村金銅久兵衛, 岡村岡田伊左衛門, 軽墓村塩野久右衛門. Neither collective, elder-fixed, nor external-administered describes a convenor-plus-steward split.

Drafted by 銀預り overlapping with those of ko_usui_bango_1822, which alternates bid and lot. Two associations, the same drafting circle, the same district, one decade apart, and different allocation rules — so the rule is a drafting choice, not a property of the tradition.

一、初会 満会迄…都合拾三ヶ年半ニ満会相成候事 — forty-one rounds over thirteen and a half years to 満会.
Same two-tier gap as ko_usui_bango_1822. The 仕法帳 cover names the drafters 世話方, and 米谷 notes 銀預り were sometimes so called — the steward role is emic and has no cell.

As ko_usui_bango_1822: 米谷 finds rules one to five substantially identical to that association's, and the 掛銀 and 当選銀 schedules nearly the same, because 岡田伊左衛門 and 塩野久右衛門 served as 銀預り and drafted the 仕法 for both. Alternating allocation therefore inherited, and equally inexpressible.
